| From \ To | D | E | F | G | H |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A | 5 | 8 | 6 | 6 | 3 |
| B | 4 | 7 | 7 | 6 | 5 |
| C | 8 | 4 | 6 | 6 | 4 |
